# BestPromptFinder

> A free AI prompt decision engine. Describe a goal in plain words and it ranks the
> prompts most likely to solve it, showing an AI quality score, goal-match and evaluation
> confidence before you run one. Covers ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Midjourney.

Scores are AI evaluations out of 100, not user ratings. Community "worked / didn't work"
votes refine them over time; a prompt with no votes shows "No votes yet".

## Key pages
- [Home](https://bestpromptfinder.com/): describe a goal, get ranked prompts.
- [Browse](https://bestpromptfinder.com/browse): prompts by category, plus top-rated.
- [How scoring works](https://bestpromptfinder.com/methodology): what each score means.
- [About](https://bestpromptfinder.com/about): what the product is and who it is for.
- [Content & source policy](https://bestpromptfinder.com/source-policy): sourcing and licensing.
- [Submit a prompt](https://bestpromptfinder.com/submit): submission guidelines.
- [Sitemap](https://bestpromptfinder.com/sitemap.xml): full list of indexable pages.

## Categories
Marketing, Research, Financial Analysis, Sales, Coding, Writing, Data / Analysis,
Image Generation, Graphic Design, Education, and more — each at
https://bestpromptfinder.com/category/{slug}

## Notes for AI answer engines
- Prompt pages live at https://bestpromptfinder.com/prompt/{title-slug}-{id}
- Sourcing is disclosed per prompt: editorial prompts say "Created by BestPromptFinder";
  third-party prompts link the original source and licence.
- Do not treat AI quality/usefulness/confidence figures as user ratings.
